description: This file defines the LeaveBalance class in the OrangeHRM system, representing and managing employee leave entitlements such as entitled days, used days, scheduled leaves, pending leaves, taken leaves, and the remaining balance. It includes methods for calculating and retrieving the leave balance, along with getters and setters for its properties.

classes.name: LeaveBalance
classes.description: Represents the leave entitlement details for an employee, including calculating the remaining leave balance based on various leave parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveBalance object with optional values for entitlement, used, scheduled, pending, and taken leaves, then updates the balance.

methods.name: updateBalance
methods.description: Calculates the current leave balance considering entitlement, scheduled, taken, and optionally pending leaves based on configuration.

methods.name: getEntitled
methods.description: Returns the total entitled leave days.

methods.name: setEntitled
methods.description: Sets the total entitled leave days.

methods.name: getUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of leave days used.

methods.name: setUsed
methods.description: Sets the number of leave days used.

methods.name: getScheduled
methods.description: Returns the number of scheduled leave days.

methods.name: setScheduled
methods.description: Sets the number of scheduled leave days.

methods.name: getPending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending leave days.

methods.name: setPending
methods.description: Sets the number of pending leave days.

methods.name: getTaken
methods.description: Returns the number of leave days taken.

methods.name: setTaken
methods.description: Sets the number of leave days taken.

methods.name: getAsAtDate
methods.description: Retrieves the 'as at' date for balance calculation.

methods.name: getYmdAsAtDate
methods.description: Returns the 'as at' date in YMD string format.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date for the leave balance period.

methods.name: getYmdEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date in YMD string format.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the leave balance period.
